title: MemoryLake on MemoryArena: A Matched Study of Agent Memory Backends
reading_scope: arXiv abstract；arXiv metadata and submission history

claims.claim: MemoryLake on MemoryArena: A Matched Study of Agent Memory Backends；2608.13883v1；版本日期 2026-08-14
需要在同一任务代理及样本上比较记忆后端，而不只测事后问答。
在 MemoryArena 五个评测域，以同框架、请求模型别名、样本和评分代码比较 MemoryLake、Mem0、向量 RAG 与长上下文。
整套后端同时改变写入、检索、预算和提示组装，并非结构单因素或成本匹配实验；区间重叠且无配对显著性检验，不能宣称通用 SOTA。
共享样本的五域等权成功率事后汇总为 20.5%，最佳对照为 13.6%；作者同时报告任务差异和不确定性。

source_caveats.detail: Paper abstract explicitly limits conclusions to workload-dependent observed performance; not representation-only, not cost matched, confidence intervals overlap and no paired significance tests.
59/221 (26.7%) progressive-query result is MemoryLake-only and must not be compared against baseline scores from the smaller shared set.
